title: MLZ firewall rules
description: Outbound rules: firewall/platform.yaml for every landing zone, firewall/landing-zones/<key>.yaml for one, firewall/management.yaml and firewall/identity.yaml for the platform's own networks. A rule names only where traffic goes; the source is worked out.

outbound.description: The rules, each with name, to and ports.

name.description: The rule's name, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; unique in this file.

to.description: Where the traffic goes: names (api.example.com, *.example.com), addresses and ranges, other landing zones by key, FQDN tags (WindowsUpdate) or service tags (AzureMonitor, Storage.NorwayEast).

ports.description: https, http, TCP ports (8443) or udp:<port>.
